external_variants.name: external_dolby_vision_p5
external_variants.title: Dolby Vision Profile 5 (IPT-PQ-C2, single layer)
external_variants.description: HEVC Main10 with Dolby Vision RPU NALs, Profile 5 (single-layer, IPT-PQ-C2). Not backward compatible with HDR10 or SDR. Requires externally-supplied sample.
external_variants.license_note: Cannot be synthesized with stock ffmpeg — requires Dolby RPU tooling or a licensed sample.

external_variants.name: external_dolby_vision_p8_1
external_variants.title: Dolby Vision Profile 8.1 (HDR10-compatible base layer)
external_variants.description: HEVC Main10 with Dolby Vision RPU, Profile 8.1. Base layer is HDR10 so HDR10 devices get valid playback; DV-capable devices use RPU.
external_variants.license_note: Cannot be synthesized with stock ffmpeg — requires Dolby RPU tooling or a licensed sample.

external_variants.name: external_hdr10_plus
external_variants.title: HDR10+ Dynamic Metadata
external_variants.description: HEVC Main10 with HDR10+ dynamic tone-mapping metadata (SMPTE ST 2094-40).
external_variants.license_note: Requires hdr10plus_tool-generated metadata or a licensed sample.

external_variants.name: external_dts_hd_ma
external_variants.title: DTS-HD Master Audio 5.1
external_variants.description: H.264 in MKV with DTS-HD MA lossless 5.1 track. FFmpeg cannot encode DTS-HD MA — only decode.
external_variants.license_note: DTS encoders are proprietary — sample must be obtained from a licensed source.

external_variants.name: external_truehd_atmos
external_variants.title: Dolby TrueHD with Atmos
external_variants.description: H.264 in MKV with Dolby TrueHD + Atmos object audio. FFmpeg cannot encode TrueHD.
external_variants.license_note: Dolby TrueHD encoder is proprietary — sample must be obtained from a licensed source.

external_variants.name: external_eac3_joc_atmos
external_variants.title: E-AC-3 with JOC (Dolby Digital Plus Atmos)
external_variants.description: H.264 in MP4 with Dolby Digital Plus Joint Object Coding (Atmos). FFmpeg cannot encode JOC metadata.
external_variants.license_note: Dolby Atmos encoder is proprietary — sample must be obtained from a licensed source.

external_variants.name: external_4k_hevc_real_content
external_variants.title: 4K HEVC HDR10 real-world content
external_variants.description: Real-world 4K HEVC HDR10 clip (not a test pattern) for realistic pipeline stress.

external_variants.name: external_vc1_bluray
external_variants.title: VC-1 Blu-ray sample
external_variants.description: VC-1 (SMPTE 421M) video, typical Blu-ray format. FFmpeg can decode VC-1 but has no VC-1 encoder — sample must be sourced externally.
external_variants.license_note: FFmpeg has no VC-1 encoder. Sample must be obtained from a licensed source (e.g., Blu-ray rip).
